note: Washington County, Iowa has a zoning ordinance and an official zoning map, but both are published only as PDF documents (the ordinance says the Official Zoning Map is kept by the planning department and is not a download). The county GIS viewer (maps.camavision.com/washingtonia) and assessor site show no public zoning district service. The county's GIS host did not respond to ArcGIS REST probes. City of Washington's zone map is a PDF/page that was blocked from reading, and ArcGIS searches for Washington County or Iowa zoning returned only Johnson County's layers. No queryable zoning district polygons were found.
